value: Returned to the dragon’s record, the story of the hilt resolves into a name: Quel’Delar, sister to Quel’Serrar. Its remembered history binds red dragonflight craft to the high elven crown and to a defender who stood before the Sunwell. The book does not make the sword’s inheritance simple. It tells how a gift can outlive a kingdom’s wound, while leaving its next bearer to be contested.
editorNote: Original paraphrase for research status. Check quest sequence, faction branch and setting against the original 3.3.5a client before lore approval. Randomized gameplay or mutually exclusive branches do not assert a unique canonical adventurer.
